What it means: The Zoning Board of Appeal convened remotely on November 5th, 2026, to hear public testimony and vote on several neighborhood project requests [00:22, 00:41]. The board approved relief for a single-family renovation at 22 Harvard Street [04:18, 05:48] and a conditional use permit to place a full-service restaurant at 81 to 81 A Prince Street [06:28, 10:06]. It also approved rear deck variances at 31 G Street [11:04, 13:12], ground-floor commercial changes for 748-750 East Broadway [14:37, 21:55], attic dormers and access work at 23 Linden Street [22:46, 24:24], a hair salon at 3615-3621 Washington Street [33:58, 36:00], and living space expansion at 55 Brown Avenue [36:39, 38:03].

Who moved it: Unnamed board members introduced and seconded the motions of approval for the projects on Harvard Street [05:37, 05:41], Prince Street [09:56, 09:59], G Street [12:56, 13:03], East Broadway [21:43, 21:48], Linden Street [24:11, 24:16], Washington Street [35:47, 35:52], and Brown Avenue [37:49, 37:54]. The transcript does not identify the specific board member who spoke each motion. For the request to install a chicken coop at 88 Lambert Avenue [25:13], a board member moved to defer the case to a full board [31:44], which was seconded [32:09] and passed [32:18]. 

What to watch: The applicant for the 88 Lambert Avenue chicken coop was directed to return for a full board hearing scheduled for the 10th [32:25, 32:28]. The board instructed the applicant to prepare detailed information addressing rodent control, neighborhood public welfare, and proof that the farm animal will not become a nuisance to nearby residents [32:33, 33:17].

summary: During the November 5th, 2026 City of Boston Zoning Board of Appeal hearing [00:20], the board approved proposals for a single-family renovation with a roof deck hatch at 22 Harvard Street [04:15-05:50], a conditional use permit for a ground-floor restaurant and four residential units at 81 to 81A Prince Street [06:25-10:08], a two-level rear deck at 31 G Street [11:03-13:13], ground-floor professional office occupancy at 748 to 750 East Broadway [14:36-21:55], attic dormer additions and accessibility work at 23 Linden Street [22:46-24:24], a hair salon buildout at 3615 to 3621 Washington Street [33:58-36:00], and extending living space into the basement at 55 Brown Avenue [36:33-38:03]. The board voted to defer a request for a chicken coop conditional use permit at 88 Lambert Avenue to be heard before a full board [25:11-32:28].
